title: FOUNDRY / OMNITOOLS
claim: A first batch of small self-contained omnitools: each file is one complete instrument (HTML+IIFE or zero-dependency Node CLI), offline, testable, with 1-3 reachable operations. Head tool is the repo/PII pattern extractor that this surface needed after a personal address had to be found in a public repo by manual git grep.

tools.evidence: fixture repo with planted fake secrets; tree+history scan found all 11 planted classes at correct file:line; --json/--redact/--fail-on exit codes verified; real public repo tree scan runs clean of personal mail domains (values withheld)
node --check clean; live browser run: 10 findings on planted sample at correct lines, mask/reveal verified, zero console errors
node --check clean; live browser run on trilingual sample: counts/entropy/Flesch band/script mix (Latin 67.4% · Tamil 8.6% · CJK 3.7%)/word+bigram ranks all computed, zero console errors
node --check clean; live browser run: 3 ta/zh/en segments aligned by index, VEIL toggles blur, row click reveals exactly one row, KEEP column honored, zero console errors

node --check clean; live browser run: CSV quoted-comma/embedded-newline/escaped-quote round trip correct; nested JSON flattened to dot-paths + array indices with empty arrays preserved; zero console errors
fixture page through all 6 modes (text/md/links/tables/meta/json) plus stdin mode; script/style content stripped; entities decoded

mutation: NEW ROUTE /foundry/omnitools/ + 6 tools + index; showcase-manifest route added; one FOUNDRY gateway card added under 02 / OPERATE
known_limits: pii-scan regex detectors are heuristics: real-name is keyword-anchored and low confidence; entropy sweep trades recall for noise (default 4.5 bits/char, pure-hex skipped).
pii-scan history scan reports patch positions (hist:<sha>:<path>:<line>); deleted-line numbers refer to the pre-image file.
html-munge is regex-based, not a DOM: malformed markup or deeply nested tables may extract imperfectly.
re-reader aligns segments by index only; unequal block counts are displayed as missing, not silently padded.
Flesch readability in text-lens is an approximation (English syllable heuristic) and meaningless for Tamil/Chinese input.
Browser tools are client-side only and never transmit pasted content.

checks: every HTML tool: node --check on each <script> block
every HTML tool: exercised live in a browser with assertions on rendered results
both CLIs: run against real fixtures with asserted output
pii-scan: calibrated against the real public repo (noise reduced: phone 1551→8, real-name 218→5 at default settings)
